reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for live DevTools-based CLS observation during user interaction. It differs semantically from peer candidates: 'Record Layout Shifts via Performance Observer' uses programmatic console-based capture (different method_family: javascript_observer vs. live_observation); 'Prefetch Content Before User Interaction' addresses content loading optimization (different task_family: content_loading); 'Configure Font Fallback Matching' addresses font metric alignment (different task_family: web_performance_optimization). Existing skills are framework-specific (Next.js Link, Script component) and do not overlap with this DevTools diagnostic technique. The candidate fills a gap in live, interactive CLS diagnosis during investigation stage.

skill.name: Monitor Live CLS During User Interaction
skill.description: Use the Performance panel's live metrics view to interact with a page in real time and observe CLS score changes, identifying which user actions trigger large layout shifts. Useful for detecting post-load CLS issues that do not appear during initial page load.
skill.skill_body:
Open the Performance panel in DevTools. Start a live metrics session. Interact with the page by clicking, scrolling, typing, or performing other user actions. Monitor the CLS score in real time as you interact. Note which specific interactions cause CLS score increases. Record the timing and magnitude of shifts correlated with each action.

## Objective

Capture and map post-load CLS triggers to user interactions
## Applicable Signals

- Disagreement between field and lab CLS measurements
- User reports of unexpected page movement after load
- Performance panel access available

## Contraindications

- Analyzing load-phase CLS only; use static load-phase inspection instead
- No user interaction expected on the page
- Field data already collected and comprehensively analyzed
- Page cannot be interacted with in a controlled environment

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Open DevTools and navigate to the Performance panel'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Locate and activate the live metrics view'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Perform user interactions (clicks, scrolls, form inputs, etc.) on the page'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Monitor CLS score display in real time during each interaction'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Record which interactions correlate with CLS score increases'}
- {'step': 6, 'action': 'Note the magnitude and timing of shifts for each high-impact action'}

## Constraints

- Requires DevTools Performance panel access
- Requires ability to reproduce user interactions in a lab environment
- CLS score must be visible and updated in real time during interaction

## Cautions

- Post-load CLS can be difficult to track without field data; this technique is most effective when combined with field measurement data
- Interactions performed in lab may not fully replicate all user behavior patterns
- CLS score changes may be subtle; careful observation is required

## Output Contract

- Mapping of user interactions to CLS score increases, with identified high-impact actions and their corresponding shift magnitudes and timing. Output enables prioritization of which layout shifts to address.
